decision.detail: A generic fallback for P0001 without a message, and an explicit status-over-code precedence in core.

rows.frontend: A RAISE with no message property returns `err.message`, i.e. undefined (callers render whatever that becomes); an empty message gives ""; `{401, P0001}` reads "session expired", `{404, P0001}` "Resource not found".

impact.adoptFrontend: MCP would return undefined for an empty RAISE.
impact.adoptMcp: Generic app shows an empty message instead of undefined.

rows.mcp: PostgRESTRequestError passes the message to Error, so a missing message becomes "" and P0001 returns ""; 401/404 are checked before P0001 as on the frontend (only the wording differs, E-01).
rows.reason: Neither is a good message: an empty or missing RAISE message should fall back to a generic text on both sides. Status-over-code precedence is reasonable but should be explicit in the core.
rows.rule: P0001 without a message: parseToHuman returns undefined (the MCP returns ""); an empty message gives ""; under HTTP 401/404 the status wins over the code
